sample_unit: Turkish speaking adult contributors (focus group participants)
unlisted_practices: Co-design of language-concordant voice AI with community contributors via patient and public involvement focus group
Advance notice of AI calls and caller identity verification before voice AI follow-up calls

screen.reason: The study conducts a qualitative patient and public involvement focus group to evaluate prerecorded voice AI calls and identify safeguard and design requirements (synthesized into a 10-point checklist) ahead of a clinical trial, but does not comparative test the effect of a specific safeguard.
